Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from target_dictionary joined to assays on tid, assays joined to activities on assay_id, activities joined to molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary joined to compound_structures on molregno. Filter to target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1795195', standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value is not null. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000.
